description: Use this layout when content needs more text space than a normal bullet slide. It is best for presenting a longer narrative split into two side-by-side text blocks. The left text box can contain the first paragraph or first part of the explanation, and the right text box can continue the same idea or contain a related second paragraph. Suitable for explanations, context sections, detailed notes, or paragraph-based comparisons. Use when the content is mostly narrative text, not bullets, tables, timelines, or cards.
